description: This Java class 'PersistenceIdSource' provides functionality to create a stream of entity IDs with revisions for known entities, utilizing Akka Streams and PubSub mechanisms. It manages stream creation, error handling, and source reference processing within an Akka-based system.

classes.name: PersistenceIdSource
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to create streams of entity IDs with revisions, handling stream lifecycle, errors, and source references.

classes.name: EmptyEntityIdWithRevision
classes.description: Private static class representing an empty or lower-bound entity ID with revision, used as a seed in stream processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a stream of entity IDs with revisions for all known entities, handling retries and backoff.

methods.name: buildResumeSource
methods.description: Builds a resumption source for streaming entity IDs, with backoff and retry logic.

methods.name: checkForErrors
methods.description: Checks for errors in PubSub responses and converts them into stream failures if any.

methods.name: requestStreamCommand
methods.description: Constructs a PubSub command to request a stream of entity IDs with revisions.

methods.name: sudoStreamPids
methods.description: Creates a SudoStreamPids object with configuration and seed.

methods.name: handleSourceRef
methods.description: Processes a reply object to extract a SourceRef and convert it into an Akka Source.

methods.name: createSourceFromSourceRef
methods.description: Converts a SourceRef into an Akka Source of EntityIdWithRevision elements.

methods.name: failedSourceDueToUnexpectedMessage
methods.description: Generates a failed Source with an IllegalStateException for unexpected message types.
